description: Answers "how loud is Paris", "noisiest cities in Europe", "environmental noise in Berlin", "quietest cities in Spain". Measured (not estimated) noise for 314 European cities in 24 EEA-reporting countries, from the EEA Environmental Noise Directive 2022 strategic noise maps; ranked by population-weighted average Lden among exposed residents. Pass a city for detail, a country and/or limit for the ranking. UK, Greece and Hungary are not covered.

country.description: Country filter for the ranking, e.g. "Italy" (optional)

limit.description: How many ranked cities when no city is given (default 10)

name: get_europe_city_noise

rank.description: Rank among the 314 cities (1 = loudest by weighted Lden)

title: European city noise (measured, EEA)
